data.name: Lovish
data.gender_notes: Lovish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Loka' which means 'people' and 'Vish' which means 'friend'. This name signifies one who is loved by the people and is a friend to all. The name Lovish carries the meaning “Friend, Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lovish usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Brings love and friendship to those around.
data.etymology: Lovish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lovish total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Lovish Chibber was the name of a medieval Hindu sage who is believed to have lived during the 12th century in present-day Punjab, India. He is known for his contributions to the Bhakti movement, which emphasized devotional love for the Hindu deity Vishnu.

Another Lovish, a 16th-century Rajput king from the Rathore clan, is said to have ruled over the Marwar region in present-day Rajasthan, India. He is notable for his military victories and for the construction of several temples and forts, including the Mehrangarh Fort.
